A little more clarity.

Answers about FloraTend's development, offline care records, voice availability and plant guidance.

In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

Is FloraTend available now?

No. The app is in development. Release requires verified functionality, supported devices, billing, translations and store assets.

Are there offline plant care apps?

FloraTend is designed to keep core plant records, care schedules and journal notes local. Its complete offline workflows must pass release testing before availability is announced.

Will it identify a plant from a photo?

Photo identification is optional and is not currently advertised as an available feature. A configured, tested engine and explicit consent for any external image transmission would be required.

Are watering reminders a diagnosis?

No. Reminder dates and observations are organisational and educational tools. They do not establish moisture needs or diagnose a plant problem.
